_comment: PUBLIC CONFIGURATION — single source of truth for editable site values.
This is a static site with no build step, so these values are ALSO written
directly into the HTML files. This file is the reference list: when you
change a value here, update the matching HTML occurrences listed under
'appearsIn'. Every place a value appears is marked in the HTML with an
HTML comment containing the word CONFIG, so you can find them by searching
Legal text is NEVER rendered by JavaScript. The privacy and terms pages are
plain HTML and remain fully readable with JavaScript disabled.
_appStoreUrlNote: No public App Store listing exists yet, so the homepage shows a
non-clickable 'Coming soon on the App Store' label instead of a fake link.
To add the real link later, see the 'Adding the App Store link' section of
README.md — it is a single edit in index.html.

_note: No app screenshots exist in the app project yet, so the homepage renders
labelled placeholder frames rather than broken elements.
Drop real PNG files at these paths and follow README.md to swap them in.
